verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine. It does ship its own way to talk to a model: a one-shot chat command with optional reasoning output, plus on-device iOS, Android, Windows and macOS apps, which loosely approximates a built-in assistant. Nothing shows an assistant that takes on and carries out delegated tasks. The OpenAI-compatible server is a building block for other tools, not an assistant, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an agentic assistant that carries out delegated tasks (tool use or multi-step actions), documentation of what the desktop and mobile apps do, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
